Subject: ALERT GGBRIDGE 11/16-11/20 OVERNIGHT EAST SIDEWALK CYCLIST DETOUR
TextBody:
Due to seismic retrofit construction, from Monday, 11/16, through Friday, 11/20, cyclists should use west sidewalk during detour. 

Monday through Thursday, 8pm - 5am, and Friday, 9pm - 7am. Thank you for your patience!

________________________________________________________________________


For trip-planning assistance, call 511/415-455-2000/TDD 711. Customer service representatives are available weekdays from 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
